codeReview.summary: The fix adds required-cell checks for scenario-defined comparators and negative tests for missing/skipped/error cells, but it does not resolve the original failure that required full per-scenario comparator matrix enforcement across ag/rust-ag/rg/ugrep.

issues.description: Required cells are computed as scenario command keys intersected with run comparators. If a scenario omits rg/ugrep command templates, those missing comparator cells are never treated as required, so validation still passes incomplete per-scenario matrices.

Harness enforcement mirrors the same subset logic (also at line 994), while comparator/template absences are still represented as skipped 'No command template' cells (lines 536 and 877). This preserves the prior failure mode for omitted comparator templates.

The fix codifies partial-scenario acceptance via test_validate_manifest_passes_for_partial_scenario (including explicit 'No rg/ugrep commands — they are NOT required' and assert-ok behavior), which conflicts with the original review failure and VAL-BENCH-001 full-matrix semantics.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Comparator completeness semantics remain ambiguous in shared state. Library guidance says comparator set is fixed to ag/rust-ag/rg/ugrep, while fix logic/tests define requiredness as scenario-local comparator subsets.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: .factory/library/benchmarking.md (fixed comparator set) vs benchmarks/validate_manifest.py:159 and benchmarks/tests/test_manifest_integrity.py:537-587 (partial scenarios explicitly permitted).

summary: Review failed: the fix improves handling of missing/skipped/error cells for scenario-declared comparators but does not fully address the original blocking issue of enforcing full per-scenario comparator-matrix completeness.
